chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever does not perform the prayer with the Imam in congregation on the day of Eid, then there is no Eid prayer for him, and no make-up is due upon him.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam under whose authority the Eid prayer is properly established
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: the ritual prayer, here referring to Salat al-'Eid
key_terms.قَضَاءَ: make-up performance of an omitted act of worship
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ: the day of Eid on which the special prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: Is Eid prayer obligatory individually if one does not pray with the Imam in congregation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Salat al-'Eid is only established when performed with the Imam in congregation. If a person does not pray it in that setting, it is not required of him individually, and he does not owe a make-up prayer afterward.
